correctness.rationale: Independently derived both local groups. In characteristic not 2, the standard theta parity quadratic refinements on the six-dimensional symplectic 2-torsion identify odd characteristics with bitangents (the effective degree-two divisor of an odd characteristic is unique on a nonhyperelliptic curve). The azygetic triple rule on those refinements is intrinsic, so an actual Cayley-octad construction is not needed in each characteristic. In the even-subset model the rule excludes length-three paths and three-edge matchings. Each nontrivial component is then a star or triangle and there are at most two; with seven edges and at most eight vertices the shapes are exactly a seven-star or a four-star plus disjoint triangle. For two meeting octad edges the number of common heptads is 1+10+5=16; for disjoint edges it is 8+8=16. Consequently the graph is connected, B B^T=56I+16J, and the matrix-tree product is 79·7^260·448^27/316=2^160·7^287. At 2 eliminate the heptad block at a bitangent sink: (16/7)(28I_27−J_27) has one local valuation 4 and 26 valuations 6, since subtracting the last generator from the others in the presentation of 28I_27−J_27 gives 26 relations of order 28 and one unit. At 7 the image of B modulo 7 is the zero-sum hyperplane: a row functional annihilating every column has, by subtracting a star from a star-plus-triangle on any quartet, equal weighted vertex degrees in each quartet. For fixed vertices i,j this gives x_ik−x_jk=−(x_il−x_jl) for any two other vertices k,l. Taking three such vertices forces all the differences zero in characteristic 7, so only constants annihilate B. The dot pairing on that hyperplane has one-dimensional radical, hence B^TB has rank 26 modulo 7. Eliminating 72I gives full and reduced Laplacian rank 28+26=54 modulo 7. The 7-primary exponent is at most 49: put C=B^TB and S=7I−C/72. For a zero-sum right-hand side (y_b,y_h) after elimination, w=y_h+B^Ty_b/72 has sum zero, C²w=56Cw, and S(7w+Cw/64)=49w over Z_(7). The eliminated equations then solve for the bitangent coordinates over Z_(7) too. Thus 261 positive 7-valuations summing to 287 consist of 235 ones and 26 twos. This verifies the entire group and the stated exponent 3136 without relying on modular script output.
residual_risks: The comparison passages on the classical geometry do not themselves state the full characteristic scope; the geometric passage to the finite symplectic model uses the standard theta parity theorem in characteristic not 2. Characteristic 2 is excluded.

value.rationale: Bitangents and Aronhold sets give a canonical incidence graph of a classical moduli-independent configuration. Its complete graph divisor-class group is a natural exact invariant: the tree count is silent on how 7-power torsion splits and the previously known column lattice measures a different object. Determining both prime-power structures is useful independently of the coordinate realization of any quartic.
residual_risks: This is the graph critical group, not the Jacobian of the plane curve or an arithmetic descent result.
